# “Best crew change flight in 28 years offshore” – What LYGG travellers tell us


Jaa artikkeli:


14.10.2026


Customer stories


For offshore workers, getting to and from work is part of everyday life. But that doesn’t mean the journey should take all day.


As our North Sea connections grow, we’ve been asking travellers about their experiences with LYGG. And some of the feedback has made our day.


One traveller summed up their experience:


**“Best crew change flight in 28 years offshore”**


Another, travelling with LYGG for the first time, told us:


**“The first experience with LYGG was good. Easy to access.”**


And when we asked what we could do better, one traveller had a very simple answer:


**“No! Perfect!”**


Or, as another traveller put it:


**“Great flight, good service. Highly recommended”**


We also receive feedback on things we can improve. We read it all, because understanding what travellers need is at the heart of what LYGG does.


Thank you to everyone who has shared their experience with us. Keep it coming!


**Travelling for work across the North Sea?** Whether it’s a crew change, site visit or business meeting, discover the connections we’ve created around the region.
